summary: One test executed and failed due to incorrect usage of Playwright API where a locator object was passed instead of a string selector.
rootCause: The test code incorrectly calls page.click() with a locator object instead of a string selector, causing a type error.

failedTests.errorMessage: Error: page.click: selector: expected string, got object
failedTests.likelyCause: Test code defect: misuse of Playwright API by passing a locator object to page.click instead of a string selector.
failedTests.recommendation: Update the test to use locator.click() instead of page.click(locator). For example, replace 'await page.click(page.getByRole(...))' with 'await page.getByRole(...).click()'.

recommendations: Refactor the test code to correctly use Playwright locator API by calling click() on the locator object directly.
Review other tests for similar incorrect usage of Playwright API to prevent similar failures.
Run tests locally after fix to confirm resolution before next CI run.
releaseImpact: High - The test failure blocks validation of the category page display functionality, potentially delaying release if not fixed promptly.
